title: Occupational Health for Health Care Providers

style_1_icd10.name: Occupational Health for Health Care Providers

style_3_monograph.summary: Health care workers are exposed to many job hazards. These can include : Infections Needle injuries Back injuries Allergy-causing substances Violence Stress Follow good job safety and injury prevention practices. They can reduce your risk of health problems. Use protective equipment, follow infection control guidelines, learn the right way to lift heavy objects, and find ways to manage stress. National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health
style_3_monograph.treatment: Consult healthcare provider for individualized management.
